title: 佛州州长候选人唐纳兹承诺降低生活成本与保障可负担性
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We are going to drive down costs for the people of this state.
segments.zh: 我们将为本州民众降低生活成本。

segments.en: We are going to lower insurance premiums for the people of this state.
segments.zh: 我们将为本州民众降低保险费用。

segments.en: We are going to make housing more affordable for the people of this state.
segments.zh: 我们将让本州民众的住房更可负担。

segments.en: We are going to protect the agriculture lands, our water and our environment here for the future of this state. In our state, we are not going to tolerate
segments.zh: 我们将保护农业用地、水资源和环境，为了本州的未来。在我们州，我们不会容忍

segments.en: bigotry of any kind, including anti-Semitism.
segments.zh: 任何形式的偏见，包括反犹太主义。

segments.en: Florida will be a state for everybody.
segments.zh: 佛罗里达州将是属于每个人的州。
